links.outcome: GPT-4o accuracy on dental antibiotic prescribing questions and justification content completeness and harm
links.effect: GPT-4o answered 72% correctly; experts rated 95.4% of justifications positively; missing content was the main weakness (7.8%); 7.1% of justifications showed moderate-to-severe potential for harm.
links.quote: Missing content was the main weakness (7.8%), and 7.1% of justifications showed a moderate-to-severe potential for harm.

links.outcome: Benchmark-style question accuracy versus real-world suitability for clinical use
links.effect: GPT-4o scored 72% on multiple-choice questions, but residual risks mean it is not suitable for unsupervised clinical use.
links.quote: However, residual risks indicate that it is not suitable for unsupervised clinical use but shows potential as a supervised AMS educational tool.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4o's performance and clinical reasoning on dental antimicrobial stewardship exam questions using an expert evaluation framework without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
